name: EmptyState
summary: Placeholder for an empty or zero-result view.

a11y.apg: No APG pattern and no role: it is a <div> with a heading, a sentence and usually an action. The heading level is yours to set through `titleAs`, because the level belongs to the document — frozen at h3 it breaks heading order. Keyboard interaction, when there is any, belongs to the `action` you pass.

props.name: title
props.description: What is not here. Required: an empty state without a sentence is a blank area.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: The heading level belongs to the DOCUMENT, not to the component. Frozen at h3, an empty state at the top of a page jumps h1 → h3 and axe fails heading-order. Pass `p` when it is not a heading at all.

props.name: description
props.description: One line on why it is empty, or on what fills it.

props.name: action
props.description: The way out — usually a Button. An empty state with nothing to do next is a dead end.

props.name: icon
props.description: Carbon glyph above the title, rendered at size xl. Defaults to `document--blank`.

props.name: state
props.type: waiting_user | waiting_approval | waiting_dependency | offline | stale | partial | degraded
props.description: Universal state (Part J). It derives no colour on purpose — an empty view is already neutral, and colouring it would be an alarm where there is only absence. What it does is set `data-state` and supply the default description, so “no connection” is not seven different sentences on seven screens.
